claims.text: The source pretrains one shared EDM denoiser on log-normal noise, then binary-tree splits and finetunes stage experts (final 3-expert: high-noise, low-noise, intermediate) conditioned on T5-XXL + CLIP-text + CLIP-image with independent dropout; same per-step cost (one expert per sigma) over 64-base + SR256 + SR1024 cascade; training-free paint-with-words via cross-attention bias.
claims.context: Correct body expert-ensemble/multi-embedding sections; title/authors verified.

claims.text: Reported numbers: zero-shot FID-30K COCO 256px Config-B 7.26 (beats Imagen), Config-D best 7.04; 4-expert at 600k beats shared baseline at 800k across the FID-CLIP curve (5K COCO + Visual Genome, CFG sweep 0-10); ~1B training pairs.
